reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI among new challenges alongside fake news
themes.definition: AI named among new challenges (with fake news and cyberthreats) as causing major changes, without further elaboration.
themes.inclusion: Include passages briefly listing AI among emerging challenges without substantive discussion.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages developing specific AI risks or policies.
themes.boundary_cases: A follow-on generic call for a joint pact does not make it substantive governance unless AI rules are discussed.

examples.quote: Some others, although of newer date, such as artificial intelligence, are already causing major changes in our lives.

themes.label: Joint pact needed for new challenges
themes.definition: General assertion that no country can respond alone to new challenges including AI, requiring a joint pact for the future.
themes.inclusion: Include passages stating AI-related challenges require collective/multilateral responses.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages with no collective-response claim.
themes.boundary_cases: Reference to the Pact for the Future could also fit AI_UN_ROLE if the UN instrument is explicit.

examples.quote: without a joint pact for the future, no country or group of countries will have the potential to offer or implement responses to those challenges alone

value.rationale: Single North Macedonian passage mentions AI briefly among new challenges like fake news and cyberthreats, then makes a generic multilateralism appeal.
